senses.gloss: (b. h. אֵי; Nun emphat; cmp. אָן)where? (only with pref. מ or ל). לְאַ׳ whither? מֵאַ׳ whence? Y. Snh. X, 28ᵈ bot; Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵃ bot. מא׳ ולא׳ whence and whither?—
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 2:4">Gen. R. s. 2</cite> <he>מא׳ הרגלים</he> whence art thou coming? i.e. where hast thou been staying?—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:2:5">Y. Snh. X, 28ᵇ</cite> top <he>היה לו מא׳ ללמוד</he> he had (a precedent) to learn from.—Contr. of <he>מן אין</he>: <cite ref="M01785"><he>מִנַיִן</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="M01692"><he>מִן</he></cite>.
